DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma.

The combination of obstructive jaundice (pale stools, dark urine), significant weight loss in an older male with a heavy smoking history, and a prior episode of acute abdominal pain is highly suggestive of pancreatic cancer causing biliary obstruction. Given the severity of the symptoms, immediate imaging is required to confirm the mass and its location.
